indexMetaDesc: Useful Imba.bet guides: Kaspi deposits, withdrawals, and bonuses for players from Kazakhstan.
indexLead: Short guides on deposits, withdrawals, and bonuses. If you still have questions — contact support via Telegram or at support@imbalance.click.
kaspiMetaDesc: How to fund your Imba.bet account via Kaspi and Kazakhstan cards: minimum deposit from 500 ₸, credit times, and common mistakes.
kaspiLead: Players from Kazakhstan can deposit in tenge (KZT), including via Kaspi. Minimum deposit — from 500 ₸.
kaspiHow1: Sign in to your account on imba.bet.
kaspiHow2: Open the deposit section in your profile.
kaspiHow3: Choose KZT / Kaspi and enter the amount.
kaspiHow4: Follow the on-screen instructions and wait for the funds to credit.
kaspiFailTitle: If the money did not arrive
kaspiFail1: Check that the transfer was made to the details from the deposit form.
kaspiFail2: Make sure the amount is not below the minimum deposit.
kaspiFail3: Contact support with the payment ID or a screenshot of the receipt.
vyvodMetaDesc: How to withdraw winnings from Imba.bet: withdrawal request, Kaspi and USDT processing times, what to check before submitting.
vyvodLead: Withdrawals are made via a request in your account. Available methods depend on account currency and settings.
vyvodHow1: Open profile → withdrawal section or finance history.
vyvodHow2: Choose a method (KZT, USDT TRC-20, etc.).
vyvodHow3: Enter the amount and payment details.
vyvodHow4: Wait for support to process the request.
vyvodBefore1: Make sure the bonus balance is wagered if you used a promotion.
vyvodBefore2: Check the details — a wrong card or wallet number will delay the payout.
vyvodBefore3: The first withdrawal may require additional account verification.
bonusMetaDesc: How to get the 40% welcome bonus on Imba.bet: registration, deposit, ×8 wager, playthrough rules, and withdrawal.
bonusHeroLead: Activate welcome after depositing, complete the wager, and withdraw winnings within the limit. All in your currency.
bonusStep1Text: A locked welcome appears in your profile in your currency. You cannot play until you deposit.
bonusStep2Text: Deposit at least the minimum within 24 h. Funds go to the main balance, 40% bonus — to the bonus balance.
bonusStep3Text: Bet from the bonus balance on outcomes or totals until you reach turnover of 8 × (deposit + bonus).
bonusStep4Text: After playthrough, bonus winnings can be withdrawn up to 1.5× the deposit amount.
bonusRule1Text: Accumulators from bonus are not available
bonusRule3Text: Outcome and total — in Live and prematch
bonusRule4Text: Outside the range — does not count toward playthrough
bonusRule5Text: Maximum per single bet from bonus
bonusRuleNote1: Withdrawal is locked until the bonus is fully wagered
bonusRuleNote2: Miss the 24-hour window — the bonus expires
bonusExtra4: Welcome — once per IP, device, and payment method
bonusPromo2: Open the promo codes section in your profile.
bonusPromo3: Enter the code at registration or manually in your profile.
